Industries

EQUIPMENT MATCHED TO THE ENVIRONMENT.

SHARK supplies across a range of UAE business sectors, each with its own equipment priorities.

01

Construction

Active construction sites carry constantly changing fire risk as work progresses.
02

Commercial Buildings

Office towers and mixed-use commercial buildings need consistent, well-presented fire equipment across common areas.
03

Facilities Management

FM teams manage fire equipment across multiple buildings and need dependable, straightforward supply.
04

Industrial Facilities

Industrial sites often combine higher fire load with process-specific hazards.
05

Warehousing

Large floor plates and high-value stock make fast-response equipment placement important.
06

Hospitality

Hotels and hospitality venues need equipment that performs reliably while fitting guest-facing spaces.
07

Retail

Retail spaces need equipment that is accessible without disrupting the customer experience.
08

Offices

Office environments prioritize clean presentation alongside dependable coverage.
09

Property Management

Property managers oversee fire equipment across portfolios of owned or managed buildings.

About SHARK

Professional equipment. Straightforward supply.

SHARK Equipment Safety and Fire Trading is a UAE-based supplier of fire fighting and safety equipment, registered for the retail sale of safety and fire fighting equipment and devices. We work with businesses, contractors and facility teams to supply the equipment their premises and projects require.
